usage_create:
Type a name (no spaces) and an emoji after the command:
`{{cmd}} create team 🟢`
usage_emoji:
Type the role name and the new emoji:
`{{cmd}} emoji team 🔵`
role_name_required: Tell me the role name right after the command.
role_created:
✅ Role {{emoji}} *{{name}}* created.
To mention everyone in this role in a message, type:
`@{{slug}}`
no_target: ⚠️ Mention (@) or reply to the message of who you want to manage.
usage_root:
*Roles*

Create a role:
`{{cmd}} create team 🟢`

Delete a role:
`{{cmd}} delete team`

Change the emoji:
`{{cmd}} emoji team 🔵`

Add someone (mention them or reply to their message):
`{{cmd}} add team`

Remove someone (mention them or reply to their message):
`{{cmd}} remove team`

See who's in a role:
`{{cmd}} members team`

See all roles:
`{{cmd}} status`

Mention the role directly in a message (no command):
`@team`

Role names are always a single word, no spaces.
